# AniManga Hub

> The most comprehensive anime, manga, manhwa and manhua database with news, recommendations and reviews.

## What we cover
- 116,000+ anime, manga, manhwa and manhua titles
- 100,000+ news articles curated by expert journalists
- 900,000+ human-curated recommendations
- Real-time trending based on news mentions

## Key pages
- /news/[slug] — anime and manga news articles
- /entity/[id] — title details, synopsis, ratings, episodes, streaming
- /search — search 116,000+ titles
- /trending — what's popular right now
- /tag/[tag] — browse titles by genre/tag

## Data sources
MAL (via Jikan), Anime-Planet, MangaDex, Anime News Network
